subject.title: fix(agents): honor Anthropic Retry-After in auto-retry backoff (#103849)

question: Should an overflowed Anthropic Retry-After make the auth profile unavailable for MAX_TIMER_TIMEOUT_MS, and should this provider cooldown metadata be part of the shared llm-core AssistantMessage contract?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically consistent, but the multi-day availability policy and shared cross-runtime type surface are ownership and product choices that automated review and tests cannot settle.

options.title: Accept the closed shared contract
options.body: Keep the optional AssistantMessage fields and maximum timer-safe unbounded cooldown, then require exact-head runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Bound unbounded cooldowns
options.body: Keep structured metadata but replace the maximum timer-safe hold with a shorter documented maintainer-approved profile cooldown.

options.title: Keep metadata runtime-local
options.body: Carry Retry-After through a narrower internal transport and failover channel instead of expanding the shared llm-core message contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the closed shared contract
recommendation.body: Keep the optional AssistantMessage fields and maximum timer-safe unbounded cooldown, then require exact-head runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available history owner across the current retry, failover, and profile cooldown paths affected by this decision.
